name: Marrock

attributes.attribute: an Arthurian hero, a werewolf who needed human clothing to assume human form
forced to live as a wolf when his wife hid his clothes to be with her lover
brought home by king Arthur, who realized he was under an enchantment
regained his humanity and his marriage when his wife returned his clothes

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Marrock was an Arthurian hero. A werewolf, Marrock could not assume a man's form unless he had a man's clothing. His wife, wishing to spend time with her lover, hid Marrock's clothes and forced him to dwell as a wolf in the hills. King Arthur encountered him and, realizing he was under an enchantment, brought him home. Marrock was so friendly to his wife that she relented and returned his clothes. Thereupon he resumed his humanity and his marriage.
objective: Document Marrock, the Arthurian werewolf hero whose wife hid his clothes.
